name: HugeProfit: Inventory, Profit & Finance – CRM for WooCommerce
author: hugeprofit

sections.description:
HugeProfit CRM is an all-in-one business management system designed for WooCommerce store owners who want deeper insight into their sales, profits, inventory, and customer activity.

🎯 Why install HugeProfit?
With this plugin, you can enter the cost of goods (COGS) directly in the product page and automatically calculate real profit for each sale. It’s perfect for entrepreneurs and teams who want to stop guessing and start making data-driven decisions.

📦 Key Features:
– Enter and manage product costs right in WooCommerce
– Automatically calculate profit per order and profit per item
– Sync WooCommerce orders to HugeProfit CRM with full analytics
– Track inventory, warehouse transfers, and supply chains
– Analyze revenue and profit per period, per product, or per customer
– Manage offline sales and expenses: rent, payroll, logistics
– Communicate with customers via Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, Viber, OLX in one interface
– Generate shipping labels and TTNs in 2 clicks (e.g., Nova Poshta)
– Use loyalty programs and discount systems
– Control production of in-house goods

📊 You get more than profit tracking. You get full financial visibility and control of your business without leaving your WooCommerce dashboard.

🖥 Access your CRM anywhere:
HugeProfit is available via browser, iOS/Android mobile apps, and Telegram. It takes just minutes to connect, and there’s a free plan for up to 50 monthly sales.

🔗 Official website | Try free

💼 Designed for:
– WooCommerce store owners
– Dropshippers and online resellers
– Marketplace sellers (WooCommerce, OLX, Prom, OpenCart)
– Small & medium businesses wanting full CRM + inventory control

Note: This plugin requires a free or paid HugeProfit account to sync and manage data. Learn more on our website.

External services

This plugin connects to external services to provide CRM functionality and ensure reliable access to the HugeProfit API:

1. HugeProfit CRM Service (crm.h-profit.com)
– Purpose: Main CRM service integration for order synchronization, inventory management, and analytics
– Data sent: WooCommerce orders, product information, customer data, API authentication tokens
– When: During order sync, inventory updates, and API authentication
– Terms of Service: https://h-profit.com/agreement/
– Privacy Policy: https://h-profit.com/policy/

2. Mirror URL Service (ingwest.net)
– Purpose: Service discovery to obtain the current working mirror URL for HugeProfit API access
– Data sent: Application identifier (“wordpress”) only
– When: When the plugin needs to discover the current working API endpoint

The plugin requires these external services to function properly. Data transmission occurs only when necessary for CRM operations and service discovery.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the ZIP archive.
    1. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
    2. Go to WooCommerce > HugeProfit CRM.
    3. If you don’t have a HugeProfit account, you’ll be prompted to create one.
    4. Log in to your HugeProfit account directly from the plugin interface.
    5. After login, the plugin will automatically connect your store to your CRM account.
    6. Complete a few quick setup steps — and you’re ready to go!

You’ll be able to manage inventory, track profits, and view analytics — all without leaving WooCommerce.

⸻
sections.faq:
Is the integration free?

Yes, it’s available on all plans, including the free one.

Does the plugin sync stock quantities?

Yes, product stock is automatically synced from HugeProfit to WooCommerce.

Can I set the product cost directly in the WooCommerce product page?

Yes, you can enter the cost price directly in the product settings.

Can I log expenses like rent, purchasing, or salaries to calculate profit?

Yes, you can record any type of business expenses from all accounts inside HugeProfit.

Can I see profit per product, per order, and by month?

Yes, you’ll be able to view profitability per product, per order, or for any selected period — including detailed business-wide reports.

Does HugeProfit support multi-warehouse inventory?

Yes, you can manage multiple warehouses, track stock movements, and perform inventory transfers between locations.

Can I connect other marketplaces besides WooCommerce?

Yes, HugeProfit supports integrations with OLX, Prom.ua, Rozetka, OpenCart, and more — alongside WooCommerce.

Is there a mobile app for using HugeProfit CRM?

Yes, HugeProfit is available as a web app, iOS and Android mobile app, and even works via Telegram.

Can I create shipping labels and track deliveries?

Yes, you can generate TTN numbers and track delivery status with Nova Poshta and other carriers, directly from HugeProfit.

Does the plugin support offline retail stores?

Yes, you can use the system for in-person sales with inventory sync, cash tracking, and customer management.

Can I chat with customers from Instagram or Facebook inside HugeProfit?

Yes, HugeProfit allows you to manage customer communication via Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, Viber, and OLX — all in one inbox.

Is there a free plan or trial?

Yes! You can manage up to 50 sales per month absolutely free, with full functionality and no time limits.
